mode_note: dry_run logs what WOULD fire (state/grow/alert_log.jsonl) and sends nothing. live sends through Anansi (email + dashboard). Switched by the principal, never by code.
girdling_mode_note: off: no girdling recommendation is made or logged. The principal 2026-10-09: girdling comes only after the water alert has proven itself live. dry_run: log what would be recommended. live: recommend through the reminder run. Switched by the principal.
levels_note: Principal 2026-10-10: keep 12 L as the low level (refill due); 10 L is DANGER - refill immediately.
switched_live: 2026-10-18 by the principal: simulated alert confirmed received in his Gmail; the first real low-water event before November is the live validation. girdling_mode stays off until that has happened.
nutrient_floor_note: 2026-10-29, the principal ('start with the nutrient floor'): Grow projects each reservoir's ppm from the plant's own measured uptake and alerts when it will cross the stage band floor within alert_within_hours. Starts dry_run - logged to state/grow/alert_log.jsonl, nothing sent - until the principal switches it live.
